The Subtask Name: Initial Planning and File Inspection

The Subtask Name: Bibliography Retrieval Attempts
Step Range: 3-10
The Oracle: The team attempts to retrieve the paper's bibliography via WebSurfer, starting with a general search, then trying to access a specific PDF link, and finally summarizing the page content.
Evidence: Steps 3-10 show multiple web searches and attempts to open/summarize a PDF from cjfs.agriculturejournals.cz, all failing to extract the reference list.

The Subtask Name: Strategy Pivot and Fact Update
Step Range: 11-12
The Oracle: The Orchestrator updates the fact sheet with new findings (table captions identified, DOI found) and proposes a new plan to use the DOI and Python for automation.
Evidence: Step 11 provides an updated fact sheet; Step 12 analyzes the root cause of previous failures and outlines a new strategy.

The Subtask Name: Data Extraction via Python
Step Range: 13-18
The Oracle: The team uses Coder to write a Python script and ComputerTerminal to execute it, successfully extracting the table captions from the Excel file.
Evidence: Steps 13-18 involve writing the pandas script, instructing the terminal to run it, and confirming the extraction of captions.

The Subtask Name: Targeted Bibliography Search
Step Range: 19-22
The Oracle: WebSurfer performs targeted searches using the specific DOI and academic databases to find the reference list of the paper.
Evidence: Steps 19-22 show web searches specifically targeting the DOI and full text of the paper to locate the bibliography.

The Subtask Name: Task Termination
Step Range: 23
The Oracle: The team concludes that the bibliography cannot be accessed despite multiple attempts and terminates the task.
Evidence: Step 23 provides the final answer stating the inability to complete the mapping due to lack of access to the reference list.
